d: Dota 2 — это многопользовательская онлайн-игра в жанре MOBA (Multiplayer Online Battle Arena), разработанная и изданная компанией Valve Corporation. Игра является продолжением оригинальной модификации Defense of the Ancients (DotA) для Warcraft III. Dota 2 вышла в 2013 году и с тех пор стала одной из самых популярных киберспортивных игр в мире. Цель игры: Основная цель Dota 2 — разрушить трон противника, который находится в его базе. Каждая команда состоит из пяти игроков, и для достижения этой цели необходимо сражаться с противниками, захватывать контроль над картой и зарабатывать золото и опыт. Основные элементы игры: Карта: Игра проходит на симметричной карте, разделенной на три линии (или "лейны"): верхнюю (top), среднюю (mid) и нижнюю (bottom). Между линиями находятся зоны леса, где игроки могут убивать нейтральных существ для получения золота и опыта. На каждой линии есть башни, которые защищают трон. Башни наносят урон врагам, которые находятся рядом, и их нужно разрушать, чтобы продвигаться к базе противника. Персонажи (герои): В Dota 2 доступно более 100 героев, каждый из которых обладает уникальными способностями и ролями. Герои делятся на несколько категорий: Керри (Carry): сильные в поздней игре, но слабые в начале. Обычно они получают золото и опыт, чтобы стать мощными. Мидеры (Mid): герои, которые обычно играют на средней линии и быстро получают уровень и золото. Поддержка (Support): герои, которые помогают команде, обеспечивают контроль над картой и защищают керри. Танки (Tank): герои, которые могут выдерживать много урона и защищать команду. Золото и опыт: Золото зарабатывается за убийство вражеских героев, крипов (миньонов) и нейтральных существ. Золото используется для покупки предметов, которые усиливают героя. Опыт необходим для повышения уровня героя, что открывает новые способности и увеличивает его характеристики. Предметы: Игроки могут покупать предметы на золото, чтобы улучшить своих героев. Предметы могут давать дополнительные характеристики, активные или пассивные способности, а также изменять стиль игры. Примеры предметов: "Медальон души" (увеличивает броню), "БКБ" (делает героя неуязвимым к магии на некоторое время) и "Манта Стайл" (создает иллюзии героя). Роли и стратегии: Игроки должны работать в команде, чтобы контролировать карту, убивать врагов и защищать свои структуры. Разные стратегии могут быть использованы, включая агрессивные (фокус на убийствах) и защитные (защита своих линий и базы). Киберспорт: Dota 2 имеет огромную киберспортивную сцену, с турнирами, где команды соревнуются за крупные призовые фонды. Самый известный турнир — The International, который проходит ежегодно и собирает лучшие команды со всего мира. Начало игры: Игра начинается с выбора героев. Игроки по очереди выбирают героев, стараясь создать сбалансированную команду. После выбора героев начинается матч, и игроки начинают сражаться друг с другом, зарабатывая золото и опыт, чтобы в конечном итоге разрушить трон противника. Заключение: Dota 2 — это сложная и многогранная игра, требующая стратегического мышления, командной работы и навыков. Новичкам может быть сложно освоить все аспекты игры, но с практикой приходит понимание механик и стратегий. Игра предлагает богатый опыт и возможность развиваться как игроку, а также стать частью огромного сообщества. zh: Dota 2 是由 Valve 公司开发并发行的多人在线战术竞技（MOBA）游戏，是《魔兽争霸3》自定义地图 Defense of the Ancients（DotA）的正统续作，于2013年正式发布，此后成为全球最受欢迎的电子竞技游戏之一。游戏目标是摧毁对方基地中的throne（主基地建筑），双方各由5名玩家组成队伍，通过击败对手、控制地图、积累金币与经验来实现这一目标。地图分为上、中、下三条路线，路线之间有野区，玩家可击杀中立生物获取金币与经验；各路线设有防御塔，需逐步摧毁才能推进至敌方基地。游戏现有100余位英雄，各具独特技能与定位，分为核心（Carry）、中单（Mid）、辅助（Support）、坦克（Tank）等类型。金币可通过击杀敌方英雄、小兵及中立生物获取，用于购买装备以强化英雄；经验值用于英雄升级，解锁新技能并提升属性。装备示例包括魔力护符（提升护甲）、BKB（短暂免疫魔法）和曼塔风格（制造英雄幻象）。游戏强调团队协作

d: Reacting to another terrifying Pocong sighting… and this one feels way too real 😳 For anyone who doesn’t know, the Pocong (aka the “shrouded ghost”) is one of the scariest spirits in Indonesian & Malaysian folklore. Legend says it’s the soul of someone whose burial shroud was never released… trapped, wrapped, and restless. They’re said to hop, not walk — bound by the cloth — appearing pale, bruised, and silent. If you ever hear knocking at night or see one watching from a distance… run. 👻 This clip is going viral right now, and honestly, the movement in the background gave me chills. Real or staged? You decide. #fyp #creepy #scarytiktoks #scary #horrortok

d: " MULTO " isn’t about the dead, but the feelings na kahit tapos na, hindi pa rin marunong umalis it lives in quiet moments— sa mga gabing tahimik pero maingay yung isip sa mga “what if” na paulit-ulit mong binabalikan hindi siya nakakatakot… pero hindi rin siya mapayapa kasi every memory, hindi naman talaga nawawala they just learn how to hide in your bones, sa paraan ng pagngiti mo, sa biglang lungkot na wala namang dahilan multo isn’t someone who died— it’s something that stayed isang pag-ibig na walang pangalan, walang simula, walang katapusan… pero habang buhay mong dadalhin kaya kahit wala na siya, you still feel haunted— not by them, but by the version of you na naiwan sa “parang tayo.” This video is created solely for our Performance Task in Physical Education (PE). The story, characters, and events shown in this video are fictional and are made for educational and entertainment purposes only. Disclaimer !! No copyright infringement intended. Credits to the rightful owner of the music, images, and video clips.
zh: 《Multo》说的不是死亡，而是那种明明已经结束却不懂离开的感觉，它藏在安静的瞬间——在那些夜深人静却思绪嘈杂的夜晚，在那些反复回味的"如果当初"里。它不可怕……但也不平静，因为每一段回忆从未真正消失，它们只是学会了藏进你的骨子里，藏在你微笑的方式里，藏在那些莫名涌上的悲伤里。Multo不是某个死去的人——而是某种留下来的东西，一段没有名字、没有开始、没有结局却要用一生承载的爱。所以即使他不在了，你依然感到被缠绕——不是被他，而是被那个停留在"我们好像在一起"里的自己。（本视频为体育课表演任务创作，故事、人物及事件均属虚构，仅供学习娱乐之用，无意侵权，音乐、图片及视频片段版权归原作者所有。）

d: Lagu Multo dari Cup of Joe punya arti yang cukup mendalam. --- Makna Lagu Multo 1. “Multo” = “Hantu” Kata multo dalam bahasa Filipino berarti hantu.  Dalam lagu ini, “hantu” bukanlah hantu harfiah, tapi metafora untuk sesuatu/​seseorang dari masa lalu yang terus menghantui perasaan.  2. Kenangan yang Tak Terlupakan Lagu menggambarkan kesulitan untuk melupakan seseorang atau masa lalu, walaupun sudah berusaha move on. Kenangan muncul terus, seperti “hantu” yang tak kunjung hilang.  3. Perasaan Bersalah, Duka, dan Refleksi Diri Liriknya menyiratkan bahwa orang yang bercerita dalam lagu masih menghadap rasa sakit emosional, penyesalan, atau mungkin kehilangan yang belum bisa diterima sepenuhnya. Ada unsur refleksi, mencoba mengerti kenapa kenangan tersebut tetap ada.  4. Peralihan Emosional dan Musik Lagu ini juga dapat dilihat sebagai pergeseran musik untuk bandnya (Cup of Joe) — dari tema yang lebih ringan ke hal yang lebih introspektif dan emosional. Memakai “multo” sebagai simbol dari konflik batin dan perubahan dalam identitas emosional mereka.  --- Kalau kamu mau, aku bisa kasih terjemahan liriknya ke bahasa Indonesia juga supaya maknanya makin jelas — kamu mau? #multo #musik #anime #kaoru
zh: Cup of Joe的歌曲《Multo》含义相当深刻。歌曲解析：1."Multo"即"鬼魂"——Filipino语中multo意为鬼，歌中的"鬼"并非字面意义，而是用来比喻过去某事或某人持续萦绕心头的感受。2.难以忘怀的回忆——歌曲描绘了即便努力放下，也难以忘记某人或某段过去的困境，回忆如鬼魂般挥之不去。3.愧疚、悲伤与自我反思——歌词暗示叙述者仍在承受情感上的痛苦、遗憾或尚未完全接受的失去，并试图理解为何那些记忆始终存在。4.情感与音乐的转变——这首歌也可视为Cup of Joe音乐风格的转型，从较为轻松的

d: "Mangkukulam" In Philippine folklore, a mangkukulam is a person, often depicted as a witch, who practices kulam, a form of black magic or witchcraft, and can cast spells or curses on others. They are known for using rituals, potions, and even voodoo dolls to inflict harm, illness, or misfortune on their victims. While often associated with negative actions, some mangkukulam are also believed to use their powers for healing or herbal magic, similar to an albularyo (witch doctor). #Mangkukulam #Philippines #Horror #Monster #Trending #Viral #AI #Veo3 #FYP

Tayang perdana pada 6 Juni 2005 silam, sinetron ini sukses besar.  Liontin sendiri merupakan sebuah sinetron remaja yang menceritakan tentang kehidupan kakak beradik Indy dan Manda, yang diperankan oleh Nana dan Naysilla Mirdad. Di sinetron Liontin ini Nay berperan sebagai perempuan bernama Indy yang terpisah dengan sang kakak saat kecil.  Kemudian Nay pun bertemu lagi dengan sang kakak setelah dewasa dan tidak menyadari mereka memiliki liontin yang sama. Keduanya diketahui harus berpisah usai ibu dan ayahnya meninggal dunia untuk mencari keberadaan sang kakek.  Sebelum keduanya pergi untuk mencari sang kakek, Manda sempat memberikan sebuah kalung dengan liontin bertuliskan nama sang ibunda, Rianty, kepada sang adik. #liontin #sinetron #nanamirdad #naysillamirdad #transformasi #transformasi90

d: The Texas surgeon who went viral for challenging UnitedHealthcare is bringing her message to Capitol Hill. Dr. Elisabeth Potter joined hundreds of healthcare workers at the bipartisan "Healthcare is Human" rally, advocating for policies aimed at addressing staffing shortages, burnout, and mental health challenges in the medical profession. Potter also spoke about her public fight with UnitedHealthcare, which drew national attention after she accused the insurer of interfering with patient care. The event highlighted proposals to support healthcare workers through tax credits and expanded mental health resources.
zh: 因公开挑战联合健康保险公司而走红的德克萨斯州外科医生Elisabeth Potter博士，将她的倡议带上国会山。她与数百名医疗工作者参加了两党联合举办的"医疗是人权"集会，呼吁出台应对人员短缺、职业倦怠及医疗从业者心理健康问题的政策。Potter还谈及她与联合健康保险公司的公开交锋，此前她指控该保险公司干预患者治疗，引发全国关注。集会还提出了通过税收抵免和扩大心理健康资源来支持医疗工作者的相关方案。

d: Stimulasi bayi baru lahir adalah bagian dari prosedur resusitasi neonatal, yaitu teknik lembut yang dilakukan oleh dokter atau perawat segera setelah bayi lahir jika bayi tidak bernapas atau menangis dengan baik. Teknik ini melibatkan penggosokan atau penepukan ringan pada dada, punggung, atau telapak kaki bayi. Tujuannya adalah untuk mendorong bayi mengambil napas pertama dan membantu mengeluarkan cairan dari paru-paru. Stimulasi ini sama sekali tidak berbahaya dan merupakan praktik medis standar yang hanya digunakan saat diperlukan, yaitu untuk membantu bayi mulai bernapas secara mandiri. Prosedur ini juga berperan penting dalam penentuan Skor APGAR, yang digunakan untuk menilai kondisi vital bayi seperti detak jantung, pernapasan, dan tonus otot, sesaat setelah kelahiran. Source: @upvoxs #viral #bayi #moment #mood #news
zh: 新生儿刺激是新生儿复苏操作的一部分，是医生或护士在婴儿出生后立即进行的温和技术，用于婴儿无法正常呼吸或哭泣的情况。该技术包括轻轻摩擦或拍打婴儿的胸部、背部或脚底，目的是促使婴儿进行第一次呼吸并帮助排出肺部液体。此操作完全无害，是标准医疗程序，仅在必要时使用。该程序也在APGAR评分评估中发挥重要作用，用于评估婴儿出生后的心跳、呼吸和肌张力等生命体征。来源：@upvoxs

Batangas Vlog! 🐶🐾 Ang munting bakasyon ng furbebi na may altapresyon 😝 #dogsoftiktok #minivlog  ‼️ Hello mga bes!! May ika-clarify lang po kami para iwas confusion na din sa mga followers namin na naengganyo magbook sa place. May naoverlooked kami sa rules and regulations dito  during ng stay namin. At yun ay bawal po ang PET sa BED. Small dogs lang din po ang allowed sa loob ng cottage (in case may furbaby kayo na gusto isama sa check in na medium - large breed) It was an honest mistake sa side namin mga bes kasi kung nabasa namin yun prior ng check in ay hindi kami tutuloy dahil katabi namin talaga mag sleep sina Chopper and Kaidae. Due to intense excitement ay hindi namin nabasa lahat yung rules and regulations under 'other policies' na sinend prior ng booking.  Based on our experience kasi sa mga past bookings namin sa mga pet friendly staycation ay wala restriction sa pag akyat ng pet sa bed. Gayunpaman, eto pa rin ay pagkakamali sa side namin. 🥹 Dinelete namin ang raw video ng pag-akyat ni Chopper and Kaidae sa higaan para hindi na gayahin ng ibang furparents na binabalak isama ang kanilang furbabies. The management is kind enough to let us keep this vlog bilang memories ng staycation namin with our furbabies. We genuinely apologize for the mistake. 🙏 🐾

d: The Traditional Dance of Bali: Legong Explained Legong is one of Bali’s most iconic and sacred traditional dances, known for its intricate eye movements, graceful hand gestures, and deep cultural meaning. Unlike modern dance trends, Legong requires years of training, often starting as early as five years old. Originally performed by young girls in royal courts, the dance symbolizes purity, discipline, and spiritual devotion—often as an offering to the gods during temple ceremonies. Today, men are also learning Legong, helping to preserve and evolve this art form for future generations. Every movement in Legong tells a story, usually drawn from ancient Hindu epics, making it more than just a dance—it’s a living expression of Balinese identity and heritage.  #bali #culture #traditionaldance #traditional #culturalheritage #dance #folkdance #culturaldiversitycostume #shorts #interestingshorts #uniqueshorts

zh: 巴厘岛传统舞蹈：蕾贡舞详解——蕾贡舞是巴厘岛最具代表性的神圣传统舞蹈之一，以精细的眼神、优雅的手势和深厚的文化内涵著称。不同于现代流行舞蹈，学习蕾贡舞往往需要从五岁起接受多年训练。该舞蹈最初由年轻女孩在王室宫廷中表演，象征纯洁、纪律与灵性奉献，常作为庙会祭神的献礼。如今男性也加入了蕾贡舞的传承行列，助力这一艺术形式延续至下一代。蕾贡舞的每一个动作都在讲述故事，通常取材于古印度教史诗，使其不仅仅是一支舞蹈，更是巴厘岛身份与文化遗产的活态表达。

d: Thai people do not say "I'm screwed." They have four different ways depending on exactly how screwed they are. 😂 แย่ละ | Yâe lá | "That's bad" / "I'm in trouble" Mild. Safe to say around anyone. งานเข้า | Ngaan khâo | Literally "work has arrived" / "here comes trouble" Very Thai. No direct English translation. You say this the moment things go wrong. ซวยละ | Suay lá | "I'm so unlucky" / "I'm screwed" Medium. Comes from ซวย meaning bad luck. Very common in everyday speech. ชิบหายละ | Chíp hǎai lá | "It's ruined" / "totally screwed" Strong. You know when to use this one.  What else you want to know? Drop it below. 👇 #learnontiktok #learnthaiwithme #thailanguage #thai #thailand
zh: 泰国人不说"我完了"，他们有四种不同的说法，取决于到底有多糟。แย่ละ | Yâe lá | "糟了"/"麻烦了" 程度轻，任何场合都能说。งานเข้า | Ngaan khâo | 字面意思"活来了"/"麻烦来了" 非常泰式，没有直接对应的英文，事情一出错就用这个。ซวยละ | Suay lá | "太倒霉了"/"惨了" 程度中等，源自ซวย（倒霉），日常口语非常常见。ชิบหายละ | Chíp hǎai lá | "完蛋了"/"彻底没救了" 语气强烈，你懂的。还想了解什么？在下面留言吧。

Instead you just add a small word: จะ (jà) = will / going to กำลัง (gam-lang) = -ing, happening now กำลังจะ (gam-lang-jà) = about to Same verb every time. Save this one, you'll use it constantly. #learnontiktok #thailanguage #thai #thailand #learnthaiwithme
zh: 泰语动词永远不变形，没有过去式、将来式，也不用记"-ing"。只需加一个小词：จะ（jà）= 将要 กำลัง（gam-lang）= 正在进行 กำลังจะ（gam-lang-jà）= 即将 动词始终不变，收藏这个，你会频繁用到的。

d: Cabai pedas + bawang putih gurih dimasak perlahan sampai garing🧄✨ Begitu denger suara kriuknya, langsung bikin nagih!  ‼️TIPS biar makin garing & tahan lama: Iris bawang putih dan cabainya harus tipis! Saat menggoreng, apinya juga jangan terlalu besar ya. Cocok banget buat stok di toples, bisa jadi teman makan atau lauk dadakan!🤤 🌶️ Bahan: 10 siung bawang putih, iris 10 buah cabai rawit merah, iris 5 buah cabai merah keriting, iris 2 sdm tepung terigu  6 sdm tepung pati jagung 50 ml air 1 sdt terasi, sangrai Garam sesuai selera Kaldu jamur sesuai selera Minyak untuk menggoreng Cara Membuat: 1. Siapkan mangkuk, masukkan irisan bawang putih, cabai rawit, dan cabai keriting, aduk rata. 2. Masukkan tepung terigu, tepung pati jagung, dan sedikit air. Aduk sampai semua terbalur rata. 3. Panaskan minyak untuk menggoreng, masukkan campuran bawang dan cabai sedikit demi sedikit.  4. Goreng sampai kecoklatan dan garing. Tiriskan, lalu masukkan ke dalam wadah. 5. Bumbui dengan terasi, garam, dan kaldu jamur sesuai selera. Aduk sampai semua tercampur rata. 6. Sajikan bersama karbo dan lauk kesukaanmu. Atau bisa juga disimpan dalam toples. #SambalBawangPutih #SambalKering #SambalBawang #MasakanRumahan #ResepPraktis
zh: 辣椒大蒜慢火炸至酥脆，听到那脆响声就让人上瘾！让成品更酥脆耐储存的小贴士：大蒜和辣椒要切薄片，炸的时候火不要太大。很适合存在罐子里，可作为佐餐小菜。食材：大蒜10瓣（切片）、红辣椒10个（切片）、卷曲红辣椒5个（切片）、面粉2勺、玉米淀粉6勺、水50毫升、虾酱1茶匙（烤过）、盐和菌菇味精适量、炸油适量。做法：将大蒜和辣椒混合，加入面粉、玉米淀粉和少许水搅拌均匀，分批入热油炸至金黄酥脆，沥油后加虾酱、盐和菌菇味精拌匀，搭配主食享用或装罐保存。

Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.

d: Mom’s Indonesian Beef Rendang 🇲🇨   What I grew up eating for over 17 years back in my hometown, Indonesia🇲🇨😍. Today, I share this recipe with you, in honor of Indonesia's Independence Day. Happy Independence Day Indonesia, Indonesia MERDEKA! 🇮🇩✨ Ingredients A: 1.4kg of beef, topside or silverside, diced into 4cm chunks 800ml of regular coconut cream 400ml of coconut milk 1 tbsp of chicken powder 1 tbsp of Sugar 2 tsp of salt 2 tbsp of coconut sugar 6 tbsp of vegetable oil for stir fry  Ingredients B, to blend: 15 cloves of garlic  3 medium onions or 250g, chopped 30g of ginger,, cut into small pieces  30g of turmeric, cut into small pieces 6 candlenuts 30g of galangal, cut into small pieces 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped 6 tbsp of vegetable oil, to blend Ingredients C: 5 bay leaves 8 kaffir lime leaves 4 lemongrass, chopped 8 cloves wholes 3 cinnamon sticks 4 cardamoms 4 star anises Seasoning: 2 tsp of cilantro ground 2 tsp of turmeric ground 2 tsp of white pepper 2 tsp of cinnamon powder Steps: 1. Cut the beef into 4cm chunks and do not cut the beef into smaller pieces as they will break down during the cooking. 2. Add all of the Ingredients B in a blender or food processor. Then, blend it or give it a blitz until all the become a thick paste. Set aside 3. In the heavily-bottomed pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. 4. Then, pour the paste (from Ingredients B) into the pan and cook the paste until fragrant for 2 minutes. 5. Add the “Ingredients C” to the pan and stir to mix. 6. Next, add the “Seasoning” and followed by chicken powder, sugar and salt to the pan. Cook the paste until fragrant ( the paste will change color to red-brown ish ) 7. Add the beef to the pan and cook the beef until it is lightly browned.  8. Add coconut milk into the pan and stir to combine. Then, add coconut cream and bring it to simmer. 9. Cover and simmer in low heat for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens. (Stir it periodically to prevent the meat from burning) 10. Once the sauce has thickened and released reddish oil, add coconut sugar and give it a final mix. 11. Cover and simmer for another 30 minutes until it turns into dark brown. 12. Once it is done, enjoy with a bowl of rice! Notes: You should let the meat sit overnight for the flavors to be fully absorbed in the meat #indonesianfood #beefrendang #dinnerideas #easyrecipes

d: Kenalin, nih! Ada nasi goreng bermarga 🥰👨‍🍳  Nasi goreng tuh masakan Indonesia sehari-hari yang hampir semua bisa bikin, tapi ga semua tahu cara biar aromanya bener-bener maksimal. Jadi, perhatiin urutan dan cara masaknya ya! 🔥😍 Yang namanya masakan rumahan sehari-hari, rasanya harus tetap istimewa ❤ NASI GORENG MARGARINE  Bahan 1 : * 500 Gr Nasi (nasi dingin sisa kemarin) * 1 SDM Minyak Goreng * 1 Batang Bawang Prei (potong 1 cm) * 2 Butir Telur Bahan 2 (dicampur rata) : * 1 SDT Garam * 2 SDT Desaku Bawang Putih Bubuk * 1/2 SDT Ladaku Merica Bubuk Bahan 3 : * 2 SDM Margarine Cara Memasak: 1. Tumis bawang prei dengan minyak sampai layu. 2. Masukkan telur, orak-arik sampai setengah matang. 3. Masukkan nasi, sambil diaduk terus hingga mengeluarkan aroma khas nasi goreng 4. Masukkan Bahan 2, aduk sampai rata. 5. Masukkan margarine, aduk rata kembali hingga margarine meleleh dan meresap ke nasi goreng. Matikan kompor. 6. Hidangkan dengan telur mata sapi, ayam goreng dan kerupuk. #margarin #mentega #idebekal #sarapan #comfortfood Resep dan Video lengkap tersedia di YOUTUBE saya : @SimpleRudyTV dan @BukuResepSatsetRudy

d: Ini nih.. Resep ayam paling GONG! Ayam Gongso ✨😍 Jangan cuma dilike sama disave doang yaaa.. masakan simple tapi gong satu ini, beneran wajib direcook! AYAM GONGSO Bahan 1: • 500 Gr Ayam (potong sesuai selera) • 2 Gelas Air • 1 SDT Garam • 1/2 SDT Desaku kunyit bubuk Bahan 2: (blender) • 1 Sachet Desaku Balado • 6 Buah Bawang Merah • 150 ml (1/2 Gelas) Air Bahan 3: • 6 SDM Minyak Goreng (untuk menumis) • 1 Batang Serai • 2 Lembar Daun Salam • 3 Lembar Daun Jeruk Bahan 4: • 150 ml (1/2 Gelas) Air • 1 SDM Gula • 1 SDM Kecap Manis Cara Memasak: 1. Didihkan 2 Gelas Air, masukkan Ayam, Kunyit dan Garam. Rebus selama 10. Angkat dan tiriskan. 2. Blender Bahan 2 sampai halus, tumis dengan 6 SDM Minyak Goreng. 3. Tambahkan, Serai, Daun Salam dan Daun jeruk, Tumis dan Aduk terus sampai naik minyak. 4. Masukkan Ayam yang sudah direbus, Gula dan Kecap Manis. Aduk dan sesekali tambahkan Air (total 150 ml). 5. Tumis dan aduk terus sampai Ayam matang dan bumbu mengental. 6. Angkat dan sajikan. #masakanrumahan #resepgampang #resepayam
zh: 最火鸡肉食谱——爪哇香辣焖鸡（Ayam Gongso）！简单却超赞，必须翻煮！食材与步骤：鸡肉500克加水、盐、姜黄粉煮10分钟沥干；将Desaku巴拉多香料包、红葱头、水打成泥炒香；加香茅、香叶、青柠叶翻炒出油；放入鸡肉、糖、甜酱油，分次加水收汁至浓稠即可

d: AYAM ENOKI CABE !!!!  Klo masak ini siap2 masak nasi putih yang banyak ya gengs !!! Asli penghabis nasi putih banget ini , pedes gurih beuhhhhh ga bisa stop makan 🔥  INGREDIENTS - Paha Ayam 500 gr - Garam & Lada Putih Secukup nya jgn terlalu banyak - 2 pack Jamur Enoki BUMBU HALUS - 10 pcs Bawang Merah - 8 pcs Bawang Putih - 3 pcs Cabe Merah Besar - 3 pcs Cabe Rawit - 10 pcs Cabe Keriting Merah Cabe nya disesuaikan ya pede nya , doyan pedes rawit nya bayakin aja BUMBU TUMIS - 1 1/2 sdm Saus Tiram - 1 sdt Kaldu Jamur - 1 sdt Gula - 1 sdt Lada Putih - 1 pcs Jeruk Nipis - Daun Bawang Wajib koreksi rasa lagi !!  STEP 1. Bumbui ayam dengan garam & lada 2. Haluskan bawang & cabe2 an  3. Masak ayam hingga matang 4. Masukan enoki dan tumis hingga kecoklatan 5. Tumis bumbu halus hingga wangi 6. Beri bumbu dan koreksi rasa  7. Masukan ayam & enoki , aduk rata  8. Masukan jeruk nipis & daun bawang  SELESAI !!! Percayalah ini muantep pol !!  - #fyp #masakanrumahan #reseprumahan #resepnusantara #resepsimpel

d: 『牛ミンチの韓国風炊き込みご飯』 【材料（3〜4人分）】 ・米…2合 ・牛ミンチ…200g ・もやし…1/2袋（100g） ・にんじん…1/2本 ・玉ねぎ…1/2個 〈調味料〉 ・焼肉のたれ…大さじ5 ・しょうゆ…小さじ2 ・コチュジャン…大さじ1 ・顆粒鶏ガラスープの素…小さじ2 ・ごま油…小さじ2 ・おろしにんにく…小さじ1 〈仕上げ〉 ・卵黄…2〜4個 ・白いりごま…適量 ・小ねぎ…適量 ⸻ 【作り方（3工程）】 ① 下準備 にんじんは細切りにする。 玉ねぎは薄切りにする。 炊飯器に洗った米、〈調味料〉を入れる。 2合の目盛りより大さじ3少なめに水を加え、軽く混ぜる。 ⸻ ② 炊飯する 牛ミンチ、玉ねぎ、にんじん、もやしをのせる。 通常炊飯する。 炊き上がったら、そのまま10〜15分保温する。 ⸻ ③ 仕上げる 全体をよく混ぜる。 器に盛り、卵黄、白いりごま、小ねぎをのせたら完成。 ⸻ 【ポイント】 ・牛ミンチの旨みがご飯に染み込んで絶品♪ ・水を少し減らしておこげを作りやすく♪ ・炊飯後に保温すると香ばしさアップ♪ ・卵黄を絡めるとまろやかでやみつき♪ ・焼肉のたれだけで味が決まりやすい♪ Korean-Style Ground Beef Rice Ingredients (3–4 servings) ・2 cups rice ・200g ground beef ・100g bean sprouts ・1/2 carrot ・1/2 onion 〈Seasoning mix〉 ・5 tbsp yakiniku sauce ・2 tsp soy sauce ・1 tbsp gochujang ・2 tsp chicken stock powder ・2 tsp sesame oil ・1 tsp grated garlic 〈Toppings〉 ・2–4 egg yolks ・White sesame seeds, to taste ・Green onion, to taste ⸻ Instructions ① Prepare the ingredients Julienne the carrot. Thinly slice the onion. Add the washed rice and all seasonings to the rice cooker. Pour in water to slightly below the 2-cup line (about 3 tbsp less than usual) and mix gently. ⸻ ② Cook Top with the ground beef, onion, carrot, and bean sprouts. Press Cook Rice and cook as usual. Once cooked, keep warm for 10–15 minutes. ⸻ ③ Finish Mix everything well. Serve in bowls and top with egg yolks, sesame seeds, and green onion. Enjoy! ⸻ Tips ・The beef adds rich flavor throughout the rice. ・Using slightly less water helps create a crispy rice bottom. ・Keeping it warm after cooking enhances the aroma. ・Mixing in the egg yolk makes it extra creamy and delicious. ・The yakiniku sauce does most of the seasoning work, making this recipe easy and foolproof. 🍚🥩🥚✨ #料理 #cooking #japanesefood #RiceCookerRecipe #炊飯器レシピ

Ingredients: - udon noodles - dumplings - bok choy - red Thai chilies - scallions - 4 cups chicken broth - 1/2 onion - 4 garlic cloves - 4 tbsp red curry paste - 1/2 can coconut milk - grated ginger - 1 1/2 tbsp sugar - salt - lime juice #thairedcurry #soup #EasyRecipe #dinner #Recipe

Easy 15-Minute Thai Basil Ground Beef 👩🏻‍🍳🤍 Ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 5 Thai chilies, or jalapeños if Thai chilies are not available 3 cloves garlic Eggs 1/2 red onion, diced 4 tablespoons oil, divided 1/4 cup soy sauce 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce 1 tablespoon sesame oil 1/3 cup oyster sauce 1 tsp sesame seeds  1 teaspoon granulated sugar 1/2 tablespoon black pepper Salt to taste, if needed 1 cup Thai basil Diced green onion, for topping Ingredients 1 lb ground beef 5 Thai chilies, or jalapeños if Thai chilies are not available 3 cloves garlic Eggs 1/2 red onion, diced 4 tablespoons oil, divided 1/4 cup soy sauce 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce 1 tablespoon sesame oil 1/3 cup oyster sauce 1 tsp sesame seeds  1 teaspoon granulated sugar 1/2 tablespoon black pepper Salt to taste, if needed 1 cup Thai basil Cooked rice, for serving Diced green onion, for topping Instructions: -In a mortar and pestle, add the chilies and garlic. Pound them down until minced. In a heated pan, add 2 tablespoons of oil. Add the garlic and chilies, then mix and sauté for about 2 to 3 minutes over medium-high heat. -Move the garlic and chilies to the side of the pan, then add the ground beef. Cook the beef for a few minutes, then start incorporating the garlic and chilies into the meat. Allow the beef to cook for about 5 to 6 minutes, or until browned. -Add the soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, sesame seeds, sugar, black pepper, and salt if needed. Mix everything really well and allow it to cook for another minute. -Add the Thai basil leaves and cook for one more minute, just until the basil is wilted. -Serve the Thai basil ground beef over rice with a fried egg on top. Garnish with diced green onion and enjoy 🫶🏻 #beef #rice #easyrecipe #lunch #dinner

d: RECIPE 👇🏼  This is how I make my pho! So many of you messaged me for a simpler recipe without beef oxtails, so here it is! ✨ #pho #recipevideo #mukbang #vietnamesefood  7 pounds of beef neck bones 7 pounds beef bones  Parboil all the beef bones for 15-20 minutes. Throw out the water and rinse away all the impurities on bones. Broth: 12.5 quarts of water 3 tbsp salt 3 tbsp chicken bullion  2-3 tbsp pho seasoning  About 2 golf ball sizes of rock sugar OR 3-4 tbsp regular sugar (adjust to taste)  1.5 cup fish sauce  2 onion  2 palm size ginger Pho spice pack  Turn stove to high and when it starts to boil turn stove to low for a simmer  After two hours of simmering, take out the pho spice bag  Let it simmer for AT LEAST 4 hours before serving! d: แจกสูตร "ผงข้าวผัด" สูตร(ไม่)ลับ รสชาติเป๊ะนัว อร่อยเหมือนเชฟมาผัดให้! #อร่อยบอกต่อ #เคล็ดลับห้องครัว #ข้าวผัด #แจกสูตร #เมนูง่ายๆ  👩🏻‍🍳🥣 ส่วนผสมผงข้าวผัดวิเศษ • ผงรสดีรสหมู: 70 กรัม  • น้ำตาลทรายขาว: 50 กรัม • เกลือป่น: 28 กรัม • ผงกระเทียม: 4 กรัม (แบบไม่ปรุงรส) • พริกไทยป่น: 2 กรัม 🍳 วิธีใช้จริง: ต้องใส่กี่กรัม? • ข้าวผัด 1 จานปกติ : ใช้ประมาณ 1 ช้อนชาสากลปาดเรียบ ไม่ต้องใส่ซีอิ๊วหรือน้ำปลาเพิ่มแล้วนะ รสมันจะนัวเค็มหวานหอมกระเทียมพริกไทยเสร็จสรรพในตัวเลย • ถ้าผัดกระทะใหญ่ (2-3 จาน): ใช้ประมาณ 2 ช้อนชา 💡 ทริคเด็ด: ผสมเสร็จแล้วเขย่าใส่ขวดโหลแห้งๆ ปิดฝาให้สนิท เก็บไว้ใช้ได้เป็นเดือนๆ วันไหนหิวๆ แค่ตั้งกระทะ ผัดไข่ ใส่ข้าว สาดผงนี้ลงไป 1 ช้อนชา จบเลยจ้าา อร่อยเหมือนเชฟมาผัดให้! 🧂💯 ในสูตรผงข้าวผัด จะมีน้ำหนักรวมทั้งหมด 154 กรัม โดยตัวที่มีโซเดียมหลัก ๆ มีดังนี้: • เกลือป่น (28 กรัม): ~11,200 มิลลิกรัม • ผงรสดีรสหมู (70 กรัม): ~11,200 มิลลิกรัม • รวมโซเดียม = 22,400 มิลลิกรัมต่อน้ำหนักรวม 154 กรัม 🥄 ดังนั้น ปริมาณโซเดียมเมื่อตักใช้ 1 ช้อนชาตวงสากล : จะได้รับโซเดียม  581.8 มิลลิกรัมต่อมื้อ 📌 องค์การอนามัยโลก (WHO) แนะนำให้ผู้ใหญ่บริโภคโซเดียม ไม่เกิน 2,000 มิลลิกรัมต่อวัน 👩🏻 คนทั่วไป / ผู้ใหญ่: ไม่เกิน 2,000 มิลลิกรัมต่อวัน (เฉลี่ยไม่เกิน 600-800 มิลลิกรัมต่อมื้อ) 🤒 ผู้ป่วยโรคความดันโลหิตสูง / โรคไต: ควรควบคุมปริมาณไม่เกิน 1,000–1,500 มิลลิกรัมต่อวัน 🧒🏻 เด็ก: ควรได้รับโซเดียมประมาณ 800–1,500 มิลลิกรัมต่อวัน (ขึ้นอยู่กับช่วงอายุ)

d: Potato Nuggets Ingredients: 3–4 russet potatoes 3 slices white bread, soaked in water 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3–4 tbsp potato starch 2 tbsp breadcrumbs 2 tbsp chopped chives Oil, for frying 1. Boil the potatoes until fork-tender, then mash them well. 2. Soak the bread slices in water, squeeze out all the excess water, and finely chop them with a knife. 3. Add the soaked bread to the mashed potatoes along with the garlic powder, paprika, salt, pepper, breadcrumbs, chives, and potato starch. 4. Mix everything together until well combined. 5. Roll and shape the mixture as shown in the video. 6. Fry in hot oil until the nuggets are golden brown and crispy. Gochujang Mayo Ingredients: 1/2 cup mayo 1 tbsp gochujang Salt and black pepper, to taste A little garlic powder A sprinkle of gochugaru

d: ✨ไข่กระทะ เป็นเมนูอาหารเช้าที่ทำง่าย อร่อยและมีประโยชน์ ไปลงมือทำกันเลยจ้า **อัตราส่วนหมูสับผัด** น้ำมันพืช 1 ชต. กระเทียมสับ 1/2 ชต. หมูสับ 200 กรัม น้ำตาลทราย 1/4 ชช. ซีอิ๊วขาว 2 ชช. ซีอิ๊วดำ 1/2 ชช. พริกไทยป่น 1/4 ชช. น้ำเปล่า 1 ชต. **เครื่องไข่กระทะ** เนยสดชนืดจืด 1 ชต. ไข่ไก่ 2 ฟอง หมูสับผัด กุนเชียงทอด หมูยอ ไส้กรอก ต้นหอมซอย พริกไทยป่น ซอสมะเขือเทศ ซอสแม๊กกี้ วิธีทำ 1. เริ่มจากการทำหมูสับผัด โดยตั้งกระทะใส่น้ำมันพืชลงไป จากนั้นก็นำกระเทียมสับลงไปเจียวจนเหลืองหอม ตามด้วยหมูสับ ผัดจนหมูสุกดี พยายามยีอย่าให้หมูเป็นก้อน แล้วใส่เครื่องปรุงทั้งหมดลงไป ตามด้วยน้ำเปล่า ผัดให้เข้ากันจนส่วนผสมเกือบแห้งดีก็ปิดแก๊ส ยกลงพักไว้ก่อน 2. ตั้งกระทะใช้ไฟกลางค่อนอ่อน ใส่เนยลงไป รอจนเนยละลายดีก็ตอกไข่ใส่ลงไป 2 ฟอง จากนั้นก็ใส่เครื่องต่างๆ เช่น ไส้กรอก กุนเชียง หมูยอ ปูอัด (ไม่ต้องนำไปนึ่งก่อน) และหมูสับผัดที่เราทำไว้ โรยหน้าด้วยต้นหอม แล้วปิดฝาอบจนไข่สุกตามชอบ 3. โรยพริกไทยป่น จัดเสิร์ฟพร้อมซอสมะเขือเทศ ซอสแม็กกี้ ทานร้อนๆอร่อยมาก #ไข่กระทะ #แม่ซีน้องมดดี้channel

d: Want Pinoy food that lasts in your fridge that's NOT adobo? Try this recipe. 🔥  This version of estofado traces back to a 1935 cookbook, and the cooking process tells a story. In a time before refrigeration, it was made to last, feeding families for days. Every bite offers a glimpse into how people once cooked with care, preserving both flavor and longevity through thoughtful techniques and ingredients. 👩🏻‍🍳  ESTOFADONG FILIPINO From the book: 1935 Libro nin Pagluto asin Pagconserva Ingredients: 1 kilo of meat (usually beef or pork) 1 cup vinegar 2 onions 5 saba bananas (ripe plantains) 2 glasses of water 1 cup sugar 1 head of garlic 1 small glass (copita) of gin (Ginebra) Procedure: 1. Fry the meat until browned. Set aside the fried meat, this will be used for the stew. 2. In a separate pot or pan, caramelize the sugar by heating it with a bit of vinegar. 3. Once the sugar has melted and slightly caramelized, add the remaining vinegar and water. Stir and cook until the mixture resembles a broth. 4. While it's simmering, prepare a pot (koron) by lining the bottom with banana leaves or any barrier to prevent the meat from sticking or burning. 5. Place the fried meat into the pot, along with all the ingredients: chopped onions, garlic, sliced saba bananas, and the prepared broth. Also, add the gin at this stage. 6. Cover the meat with banana leaves to seal in moisture and flavor. 7. Cook over low heat, and once it starts boiling, reduce the fire further and let it slowly cook until the meat is tender. 8. Once done, this dish can be preserved for up to a month, and reheated only when ready to serve. #fyp #featrmedia #filipinofood #estofado
zh: 想要一道不是阿斗波、却能在冰箱里久放的菲律宾菜？试试这道食谱。这版 Estofado 源自1935年的食谱书，做法本身就是一段历史。在冰箱尚未普及的年代，这道菜是为了长久保存而生，能供一家人吃好几天。每一口都能感受到那个时代人们用心烹饪、以巧妙技法和食材保留风味与保鲜的智慧。菲式 Estofado（取自1935年《烹饪与保存之书》）食材：肉类（牛肉或猪肉）1公斤、醋1杯、洋葱2个、熟香蕉（saba蕉）5根、水2杯、糖1杯、大蒜1头、杜松子酒（Ginebra）1小杯。做法：1.将肉煎至上色备用；2.另起锅，加少许醋将糖加热焦糖化；3.糖融化略焦后加入剩余醋和水，搅拌煮成类似高汤的液体；4.取一口锅，锅底铺上香蕉叶以防粘底烧焦；5.将煎好的肉放入锅中，加入切碎的洋葱、大蒜、切片的 saba 蕉及熬好的汤汁，同时加入杜松子酒；6.用香蕉叶盖住肉，锁住水分与风味；7.小火慢炖，沸腾后进一步调小火候，直至肉质软烂；8.成品可保存长达一个月，食用时再加热即可。

d: 🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

Growing up I never even thought to try laing because of the way it looked. But as an adult I finally gave it a shot and holy sh*t it's so good. Easily one of the most underrated dishes in the Filipino kitchen. The secret is fresh coconut milk I made mine from scratch (full how-to in my last post, made it specifically for this). And one rule: once the taro leaves go in, don't touch them. Let them sink and drink up the coconut milk so they cook all the way through. Please see recipe below: 1/2 lb pork belly, diced 1 Onion, sliced 3Tbs minced Garlic 3Tbs minced Ginger 1tsp black peppercorns 1/3C bagoong (shrimp paste) 3.5oz dried taro leaves 6C fresh coconut milk (first cook, to get the leaves tender) 2C fresh coconut milk (added after leaves are tender + can mix) 2 long green chilies 3–4 fresh red Thai chilies (more if you like it spicy) Fish sauce, to taste Best served with warm rice. Even better the next day.

How to make Pork Binagoongan. A Filipino pork dish that's unique and delicious. BAGOONG or fermented shrimp paste is the star ingredient in this dish. It has a bold, funky aroma that doesn't exactly whisper "eat me" but don't let the smell fool you. Much like blue cheese, anchovies or well-aged French cheese, some of the world's most beloved foods are a little intimidating before they become irresistible. The bagoong transforms the tender and soft pork into a rich, umami-packed dish that's salty and savory. d: 🇵🇭 Pork Binagoongan | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 11 One of the more underrated but S tier Filipino dishes!! Usually made with pork simmered in “bagoong alamang”, or fermented shrimp paste - best served with rice, sometimes with eggplant or green mango on the side. Its savory, funky, and slightly sweet, with tons of umami 💡Pro tip: adjust depending on your bagoong. Not all bagoong tastes the same — some are saltier, milder, or sweeter — so taste as you go and balance it out with sugar, vinegar, and tomatoes. INGREDIENTS: Binagoongan: - 1.5 kg pork ribs, blanched (you can use pork belly or cut of choice) - 5-6 tbsp bagoong guisado - 1 large onion, diced - 15-20 cloves garlic, sliced - 4 long green chilies, sliced - 350g tomatoes, sliced - 1/3 cup cane vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar - 1/4 cup soy sauce - Water as needed - Black pepper, to taste Bagoong Guisado: - 400g shrimp paste (alamang) - 25-30 cloves garlic - 7-10 red chilies - 6-7 shallots - 400g tomatoes, diced - 1/4 cup vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar Ensaladang Mangga: - Green mango - Red onion - Cilantro - Tomato - Lime - Salt - Pepper INSTRUCTIONS:  - Blanch pork for 10 minutes, before straining and rinsing. Set aside. - To make the bagoong start by blitzing onions or shallots, garlic, and red chilies in a processor.  Add to cold pan with oil and cook until garlic is slightly oasted add tomatoes, alamang, sugar and vinegar. Allow this to simmer until the oil comes out and the tomatoes are jammy. - For the binagoongan start by sauteing onions, garlic, and chilies. add back your meat and all other ingredients listed under  “Binagoongan” and simmer for 40mins-1hr or until tender - In the meantime you can pair this with a fresh ensalada by combining all ingredients under “ensalada”. - Serve and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

d: 🇵🇭 Beef Salpicao | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 12 My take on a delicious FIlipino-Spanish dish usually made with tender beef cubes cooked in garlic, butter and Worcestershire sauce — but with extra garlic flavor!  * this recipe is only a guideline. most ingredients are just estimates so taste and adjust with your ❤️ INGREDIENTS: Beef salpicao: - 500g ribeye steak (or any cut of steak of your choice) - 300g of button mushrooms - Salt and pepper to taste - Oil for frying - 1/4 block of butter - 15-20 cloves of garlic, minced - 3 tbsp of Worcestershire sauce  - 1  tbsp of oyster sauce  - 2 tbsp of paprika  Garlic confit: - 300g of peeled garlic cloves - Olive Oil to cover Garnish: - parsley - crunchy garlic - pickled peppers INSTRUCTIONS: - Start by seasoning your steak and grilling until medium rare. Slice them into bite sized chunks and set aside for later - Slice button mushrooms. In a pan , add oil and/or butter, sauté the button mushrooms until they get deeper in color. Season with salt and pepper.  - Add minced garlic to a hot pan with oil and butter, and saute unti fragrant. Add back your steak and mushroom and add Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce, paprika and black pepper. - To make it extra garlicky, we’re adding some garlic confit. To make it, simply add peeled garlic to a pot, cover with oil, and cook low and slow until the cloves are soft and golden. - Serve with garlic rice and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR # FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

d: Filipino Style Grilled Pork Belly  Ingredients: 2 lbs pork belly preferably with skin on Marinade: 1/4 Cup Banana Ketchup 1/2 Cup Soy Sauce 1/8 Cup Calamansi Juice or lemon/lime juice 6 minced cloves garlic  1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp kosher salt Toyomansi sauce: 1/3 cup soy sauce Calamnsi juice to taste 1-2 thai chili peppers Instructions: 1. Grabe ang Sarap ng Balbacua! 🐮 Lutong Bahay na Comfort Food sa Pata ng Baka! #Balbacua #PinoyRecipe  Balbacua Recipe — rich, flavorful, and comforting Pinoy beef stew! 😋 Malambot na beef pata na niluto sa tausi at tomato sauce — perfect sa kanin 🍛 🧂 Ingredients: • 1 kg Beef Pata (Trotters)  Pakuluan sa tubig na may sibuyas, luya, at asin, pressure cook 45 mins. • 1 tbsp cooking oil • 1 thumb-size ginger (sliced) • 1 large onion (chopped) • 5 cloves garlic (minced) • 1 tbsp annatto (anato) powder • 1 small red bell pepper (sliced) • ½ cup tomato sauce • 2 tbsp tausi • 1 tsp black pepper powder • 2 pcs spicy green chili • 2 pcs siling pansigang • 1 pc broth cube • 1L water • Spring onions & toasted garlic (pang garnish) 🔥 Procedure: 1️⃣ Painitin ang mantika, igisa ang luya, bawang, at sibuyas. 2️⃣ Idagdag ang annatto powder at red bell pepper. 3️⃣ Ilagay ang pinakuluang beef pata at haluin. 4️⃣ Isama ang tomato sauce, tausi, black pepper, sili, broth cube at tubig. 5️⃣ Pakuluin hanggang lumapot at malasa. 6️⃣ Timplahan ayon sa panlasa, lagyan ng spring onions at toasted garlic. 🍛 Best served with: steamed or fried rice! #Balbacua #PinoyRecipe #FilipinoFood #LutongBahay #ComfortFood #BeefPata #Cookingtripco #Foodtok #SarapNgPinoy #HomeCooking #FoodVlog #RecipeVideo #foryou

d: Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 6. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm. #bread #garlicbread #breadtok #baking #homemadebread

d: Steak and Rigatoni Alfredo Bread Bowl 🥹 I think I need a bigger bowl next time. Otherwise, absolutely perfect. Full recipe below ⬇️  • Ingredients: 1 thick cut NY strip 12oz rigatoni pasta 2 small sourdough boules 1/4 cup butter Rosemary and Thyme Garlic cloves • Steak Alfredo Sauce: 1/4 cup butter 2-3 minced garlic cloves Leftover steak juice 1/4 cup flour 1.5-2 cups heavy cream 1 cup parmesan ~1/4 cup pasta water  • Instructions: -Boil a pot of water and dump in rigatoni and 1 Tbsp of salt. Let that boil until pasta is al dente (about 11 mins). Once they’re ready, dump out most of the water and place pasta in a bowl of cold water  -Season steak and cook on medium heat in a cast iron skillet. I like to use chef presses to get a perfect crust. Flip over and bring in the butter, herbs, and garlic. Baste until internal temp reads 115°F. Let rest on a plate with the remaining butter poured on top -Cut bread about 1/3 the way down from the top horizontally and scoop out inside to resemble a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and broil in the oven for about 5-10 minutes until crispy -For the sauce, add in butter, some steak juice, garlic, flour, heavy whipping cream, and Parmesan. Let that all get creamy, then add in the rigatoni and pasta water. Stir until all incorporated. Take off the heat -Cut through the rested steak, bring out the bowls and fill them with rigatoni first, then steak, then top with more sauce, parm, and parsley. Enjoy! • Hope you like this as much as I did 🙌🔥

d: Chicken Alfredo Garlic Bread 🥰😍 100/10!!………………………….. Chicken: Season Chicken breast with  • Oil • Garlic powder • Onion powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Salt ( a small amount) •Tony’s Creole  • Black pepper Rub seasonings in and pan sear then set aside   Sauce: • 2-3 cups Heavy cream • One bag of Parmesan Cheese •Minced  Garlic • Butter • Same seasonings from chicken  Add butter in a pan first, after melted add minced garlic and cook until you can smell it. d: I think these are the biggest onions I’ve ever seen?! 🧅 French onion meatballs & Parmesan orzo did nottt disappoint  Recipe adapted from @Revi 🫶🏼☺️ For the onions: - 2 large yellow onions - 2 tbsp butter  - Pinch of salt For the meatballs: - 1 lb lean ground beef - 1 egg - 1/2 cup Parmesan - 1/2 cup Italian breadcrumbs - 1/4 cup Parsley, chopped - 4 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp Worcestershire  - 1/2 of the caramelized onions - salt, pepper, garlic powder to taste For the sauce: - other 1/2 of caramelized onions - 1/2 cup white wine - 1 cup beef bone broth - 1 tbsp tapioca flour - 1 tbsp water For the orzo: - 4 servings orzo, cooked & drained - 1/2 tbsp butter - 1/4 cup half & half (I used DF) - 1/2 cup grated Parmesan - salt, pepper & garlic powder to taste  In a large pan, caramelize onions by cooking them over medium heat with the butter & salt for 30-40 minutes or until done While the onions are cooking, prepare meatballs by combining all ingredients in a large bowl (including 1/2 of the onions once they’re done). Mix until combined & roll into balls. In the pan you cooked the onions in, add the meatballs and cook on each side for 3-5 minutes. Once cooked through, remove from the pan. Add the other 1/2 of the onions back to the pan, along with the white wine and bone broth. Combine the tapioca flour & water into a slurry and add to the sauce to thicken. Add meatballs back in and let simmer for 10-15 mins. For the orzo, combine cooked orzo with the cream, butter, Parmesan & seasonings. Once everything is done, plate & top with parm & parsley! #cookwithme #cookingtiktok #cookingasmr #dinnerideas #easymealideas

d: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta 🍝 Ingredients 1 chicken breast (cut in half) ½ tbsp paprika ½ tbsp garlic powder ½ tbsp onion powder 1 tsp salt 1 tsp black pepper Dash of olive oil 3 cups cooked pasta 2 tbsp olive oil 2 tbsp butter 1 small onion, diced 3 garlic cloves, minced 1½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved 1 tbsp tomato paste ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes 1 tbsp Italian seasoning 1 tbsp paprika Salt and pepper to taste ¾ cup heavy cream ½ cup pasta water 2 cups spinach (or less if preferred) 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese Instructions: - Season chicken with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. - Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook on both sides until golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove from the pan and set aside. - In the same pan, add butter and diced onion. Cook until onions are translucent, then add minced garlic and cook for about 1 minute. - Stir in cherry tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add tomato paste and sun-dried tomatoes, stirring for another minute. - Add Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute, then pour in the heavy cream and pasta water. Stir well and let it simmer for 2 minutes. - Add spinach and Parmesan cheese. Stir until the cheese is melted and the sauce is creamy. - Slice the cooked chicken and return it to the pan. Let it simmer briefly to absorb the flavors, then add the cooked pasta. Toss until everything is evenly coated. - Garnish with extra Parmesan and serve warm and enjoy! #pasta #chicken  #ho#homemadefoodunch #dinner

Say ‘YES’ if you love these easy one pan meals with minimal cleanup! 🙋🏻‍♀️ HIGH PROTEIN CHICKEN RAMEN 🍜  Ingredients (for base): 2.5cups bone broth (I used chicken flavor) 1 can full fat coconut milk 2Tbsp low sodium soy sauce 3 cloves minced garlic 1tsp sesame oil 1tsp maple syrup 2tsp paprika Juice of 1 lime Ingredients (for noodles): 3 packs of ramen noodles (I used momofuku) 1 red bell pepper (sliced) 1 carrot (julienned) 1c broccoli florets 1/2c shiitake mushrooms 1/2c frozen edamame 3 scallions (whites in the noodle & greens as topping) 2-3cups shredded rotisserie chicken Sesame seeds or cashews for topping Directions: 1.Preheat oven to 400F 2.In a 9 x 13 pan add all base ingredients and mix 3.Add in your noodles, chopped veggies and chicken 4.Cover and bake for 25 mins 5.Uncover, mix halfway through and finish baking uncovered 6.Let sit for 5-10 mins, top with scallions and sesame seeds and enjoy! #onepanmeal #highproteinmeal #easydinner #healthymeal

d: Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

d: you hear a smoke alarm chirp once late at night— Don’t walk straight toward it. Stop in the hallway. Listen first. Because low batteries chirp regularly. They don’t usually chirp once. If the alarm chirps again but from a different room— Don’t start searching the house. And if the third chirp sounds closer than the first two— Don’t call out. Because people who ignored that rule all said the same thing later. The chirp didn’t come from the ceiling anymore. It came from somewhere lower. If the alarm suddenly chirps again right behind you in the hallway— Don’t turn around. Because smoke alarms are mounted to ceilings. But if the chirp keeps changing locations inside your house— It usually means something is carrying the sound room to room while you try to figure out where it’s coming from. ⸻ 🔎 KEYWORDS smoke alarm chirp horror story house alarm creepy encounter moving smoke alarm sound story home alone suspense story smoke detector night horror alarm sound moving house story home safety device horror house hallway suspense story smoke alarm thriller scenario inside house creepy sound story ⸻ HASHTAGS #FrankieBryant #ScaryStory #Storytelling #StayAware #NightProtocol

d: WE’ve been praying for times like this🥹🥹🥹🥹  #analoghorror #movies #cinema #mandelacatalogue #fyp  i really really hope this isnt a fake news or im  gonna cry —— The Mandela Catalogue is a 2021 analog horror franchise created by American YouTuber Alex Kister. It is set in the fictional Mandela County in the United States. In the series, Mandela County is invaded by otherworldly entities called Alternates that psychologically torture their victims with the ultimate goal of assuming their identities as doppelgängers. The series became popular online, in part due to reaction videos and story analyses of it by internet users and YouTubers. Primarily set during the early 1990s and late 2000s, The Mandela Catalogue takes place within the fictional Mandela County, located in Wisconsin, which is terrorized by shape-shifting creatures named Alternates. Alternates, led by a false depiction of the Archangel Gabriel, are nearly-immortal beings that aim to eradicate humanity by psychologically torturing them to the point of suicide. The Alternates can manipulate audiovisual media, such as televisions, personal computers, and vehicle GPS systems.

d: Chicken caesar garlic knot sandwiches ✨ I used my standard brioche milk bread recipe for the rolls and added 1 tbsp of garlic powder and topped it with garlic butter. Ingredients  - 1.5lb boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced thinly - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp paprika  - Salt and pepper to taste  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) Breading - 3 eggs - 1 1/2 cups panko bread crumbs  - 1 cup all purpose flour  - 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded (for breadcrumbs) - Salt and pepper to taste  - Parsley (breadcrumbs) Caesar dressing - 1 cup mayonnaise  - 1/2 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded  - 2 tbsp olive oil  -  1 tbsp worcestershire - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1/2 tbsp garlic paste - 1 tsp black pepper  - 1 tsp anchovy paste - 3 cups romaine lettuce, chopped - Salt to taste  Instructions  - In a bowl, combine thinly sliced chicken breast, olive oil, oregano garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, msg if using and pepper. Let marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes (or up to overnight for best flavor). - Set up 3 bowls: flour in one, beaten eggs in another, and panko + Parmesan in the third. - Remove chicken from bowl, then dredge in flour → egg → panko-Parmesan mix. - Heat oil in a skillet (350°F/175°C) and fry chicken cutlets 3–4 mins per side until golden and crispy. - Place on a wire rack or paper towels to drain. - In a large bowl combine mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, anchovy paste, olive oil, Parmesan cheese, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk until well combined. - Add chopped romaine lettuce and mix in until evenly coated. - Spread Caesar dressing on both top and garlic knot roll. - Add Caesar salad mixture, then place a crispy cutlet on top. - Sprinkle with extra Parmesan, add top of the garlic knot roll, brush with garlic butter and serve hot! • • • #recipeideas #chickenrecipes #recipe #foodideas

d: Lemon garlic salmon pasta ✨🍋 Ingredients  Salmon - 4 salmon fillets - 1 tsp kinder’s lemon garlic butter seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1 tsp paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - Salt and pepper to taste - 1 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp avocado oil  - 14 oz fettuccine  Cream sauce - 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream - 1/4 cup lemon juice - 1/4 cup pasta water - 1 lemon, zested - 3 tbsp butter  - 6 garlic cloves, minced - 2 shallot, finely chopped  - 1 cup Parmesan cheese  - 1 heaping tsp garlic powder  - 1 heaping tsp kinders lemon garlic butter sesoning - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. - Cook fettuccine according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain and set aside. - Pat salmon filets dry. - Rub with avocado oil, then season with paprika, garlic powder, oregano, kinders lemon garlic butter seasoning, salt, and pepper. - Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and butter. Sear salmon for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, basting with the pan drippings. Remove and set aside. - In the same skillet, reduce heat to medium. Add butter and let melt. Sauté shallot for about 3 minutes until softened, then add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice and heavy cream. Let simmer for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened, then add lemon zest. - Add seasonings and freshly grated Parmesan. Stir until smooth. Pour in reserved pasta water and mix until the sauce is well combined. Taste and adjust salt and pepper as needed. - Add cooked pasta to the skillet and toss until evenly coated in the sauce. - Garnish with fresh parsley and serve alongside the salmon. • • • #Recipe #DinnerIdeas #pasta #salmonrecipe #recipeideas

d: MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. Absolute comfort food - elevated. #mash #shortrib #cooking #recipe #food

d: Cowboy butter steak bites ✨ My husband ate both of these plates and rated it a 10/10 😭 Ingredients  Steak - 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, cubed - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount) “Caramelized” onions  - 1 large yellow onion, sliced - 1 tsp granulated sugar  - Heaping pinch of salt Cowboy butter - 12 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 garlic cloves, minced  - 1 shallot, minced  - 1 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference  - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste  Instructions  - Toss cubed steak with oil, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside while the pan heats. - Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. - Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside. - Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed). - Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium. - Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt. - Add steak back to the pan. - Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes. - Serve over creamy mashed potatoes and enjoy! • • • #recipe #steak #dinnerideas #food #steak

d: Lemon curd recipe 🍋🧈👇 In the grey of winter, making the little things nice for yourself is all the more important, and lemon curd does just that. It just hits the spot every time, in yoghurt, between sponge cakes, or especially on crumpets. In the video I made 5 times the recipe below, but this quantity is nice for a normal batch! Ingredients: 4 large eggs 5 unwaxed lemons 280g caster sugar 230g butter Method: Finely zest and then juice the lemons. Into a saucepan, add your eggs and beat lightly. Add in the sugar, butter, lemon zest and lemon juice. Place over a medium heat and whisk continuously until the sugar dissolves and the butter melts. Do not allow it to boil as it may split. When it has all combined and the mixture coats the back of a spoon (this may take about 10 minutes and if you have a thermometer is about 77°C) remove from the heat. Place it through a sieve to catch any zest or seeds. Pour into sterilised jars and seal. Store in the fridge. . . . #cookingfromscratch #homecooking #lemoncurd #marmalade #crumpets

d: Creamy beef and shells 🔥 This one’s a WINNER. Here’s how to make it: 1 T olive oil (I used @Brightland rosemary) 1 yellow onion, diced 6-8 cloves garlic, minced (to taste) 1 t red pepper flakes, to taste 1 t Italian seasoning Salt and pepper, to taste 1 t smoked paprika, to taste (can sub regular) 1 lb grass-fed ground beef 2-3 T tomato paste 3 cups beef broth (I used @Kettle & Fire)  1 cup heavy cream 1 lb medium pasta shells 4 oz freshly shredded sharp cheddar cheese (I use @Tillamook)  Fresh chives, to garnish 1. In a large saute pan (I use @Misen), heat your olive oil over medium/low heat. Add in your onion, red pepper, Italian seasoning, and a pinch of salt. Saute for a few minutes. Throw in your garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 2. Add in your ground beef and season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Break up with a wooden spoon and cook until no longer pink. 3. Once your beef is cooked through, make a small center in the middle of your pan and add in your tomato paste. Let it cook off in the pan for a couple minutes before stirring everything together.  4. Pour in your beef broth and cream, season with a pinch of salt and pepper. Bring to a low boil. 5. Reduce heat to low. Pour in your uncooked pasta and stir. Simmer, uncovered, for 16-17 minutes, or until your pasta is tender.  6. Sprinkle in your cheese, stir, and taste for seasonings.  7. Top with extra cheese and garnish with fresh chives. Enjoy! Serves 6 Prep: 10 min Cook time: 30-40min #onepan #onepanmeal #onepot #onepotmeals #onepotpasta #beefandshells #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easydinner #easydinnerideas #dinner #dinnerideas #weeknightdinner #easymeal #foodtok #hamburgerhelper #pastatok #onepanrecipe #onepotrecipe

d: Chicken Alfredo garlic bread ✨🧄 This + a Caesar salad sooo good! Recipe is for two but can be used for one big longer French roll. Ingredients - 1 loaf French bread or Italian bread - 3 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 cloves garlic, minced - 2 boneless skinless chicken breast  - 1 cup heavy cream - 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese - 1 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese (1/4 for pasta sauce the rest for bread) - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp red chili flakes  - Salt and black pepper to taste - Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish) Garlic butter - 1 stick unsalted butter, softened  - 2 tbsp parsley, chopped - 1/4 cup Parmesan  - 2 tsp garlic paste - 1 tsp garlic powder - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Set to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. - Slice the loaf in half lengthwise. In a small bowl, mix softened butter, garlic paste, parsley, garlic powder, salt, pepper and stir until combined. - Brush evenly over both halves of the bread. Toast in the oven for 5–7 minutes until slightly golden. (Optional) - In a saucepan over medium high hear sear chicken breast on both sides for 5-8 minutes or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove from pan. - In the same pan, add butter, and minced garlic. Cook until fragrant about 1-2 minutes. Add heavy cream and Stir until smooth. - Add mozzarella, Parmesan cheese and stir until melted and creamy. - Season with garlic powder, oregano, basil, red pepper chili flakes, salt and pepper. - Spoon the Alfredo sauce evenly over each bread half. Sprinkle extra mozzarella on top. Add sliced chicken and more Alfredo sauce. - Return to the oven for 15-25 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. - Garnish with chopped parsley. - Slice and serve warm. • • • #Recipe #recipeideas #garlicbread #DinnerIdeas

Cheeseburger Rice is an easy one pan meal that can be made in less than 30 minutes for under $10!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb of ground beef  1 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 chopped onion 1 1/2 cups of beef broth  1 cup long grain white rice, rinsed  8 oz can of tomato sauce  1 tbsp minced garlic  1 1/2 cups of shredded Colby Jack cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown 1 lb of ground beef with chopped onion. Season with salt, pepper, paprika, oregano, garlic powder and onion powder.  Once the beef is browned, drain any extra grease if needed.  Add the minced garlic and stir.  Next, add the rinsed uncooked rice, beef broth, and tomato sauce to the skillet. Stir everything together well. Bring to a quick boil and turn heat down to low. Cover with a lid and cook for about 15 minutes stirring once or twice to keep the rice from sticking to the bottom of the pan.  Once the rice is cooked add about 1 cup of cheese and stir. Top with a little bit more cheese and let sit on the stove until the cheese melts or put it in the oven under broil for just a couple of minutes. Top with dried parsley. Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out!  #onepandinner #skilletdinner #groundbeef #easyrecipes

Croissant smash burgers ✨  Ingredients  Burgers - 1.5 pounds ground beef (80/20) - iceberg lettuce - tomatoes, sliced  - american cheese or sharp cheddar, slices  - croissants  - Salt and pepper to taste caramelized onions - 2 large white onions, diced - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 2 tbsp butter - 1 tsp granulated sugar - 1/2 tsp salt sauce  - 1 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup ketchup  - 1/4 cup caramelized onions  - 1/4 cup pickles, finely chopped  - 1 tbsp yellow mustard  - 1 tsp distilled white vinegar or pepperoncini - 1 tsp sugar - 1/2 tsp salt  - 1/4 tsp black pepper  Garlic butter - 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted - 2 tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1 tsp garlic paste  - Salt to taste  Instructions: - In a medium bowl, combine mayonnaise, mustard, ketchup, onions, pickles, salt, pepper, sugar, and vinegar together.  Cover and refrigerate while you prepare the rest. - Heat a small pan over low heat with 1 tbsp oil and butter. Cook onions slowly for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden brown, and sweet. Set aside. Burgers  - Divide the ground beef into 4 equal portions (about 100g each) - Roll each into a ball, then flatten into thin croissant shaped patties about 1/4-inch thick. (Wider than the bun – they'll shrink.) Sh - Season one side generously with salt and pepper. Keep chilled until ready to cook. Buns  - Cut the croissants in half - Lightly butter the cut sides. - Toast them cut-side down in a dry skillet or griddle over medium heat until golden and crispy. Remove and set aside. Cook the Burger Patties - Heat a skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Add a thin layer of oil. - Add patties (2 at a time, don’t overcrowd).  - Cook for 2 minutes on the first side until browned. Add mustard and spread evenly. - Flip and immediately add a slice of American cheese to each patty. - Cook for another 1–2 minutes, until cheese is melted and the patty is cooked through. - Assemble burger with sauce, desired toppings, and enjoy! d: LEMON BRÛLÉE 🍋 RECIPE ⬇️ This is a very simple but incredibly effective dessert. I saw a bunch of these recipes going around last summer, and thought I’d give it a go - well worth it. - Using 4 lemons (get ones without wax on the shell, as will use the zest), split 3 of them in half lengthways and remove the flesh  - Pass the flesh through a sieve measure out around 110ml, and reserve it in a bowl - In a saucepan add 500ml whipping cream, 120g white sugar, and the zest from the 4th lemon. Bring to a simmer and reduce slightly until it coats the back of a spoon - Pour the mixture back into the lemon shells and chill in the fridge for 6 hours or overnight - Top with brown sugar and use a torch to melt / brown it - Serve once the sugar has set hard #lemon #dessert #brulee #posset #cooking

Honestly, if it used to have a heartbeat, Maverick is interested. So I combined both worlds and made spicy ramen topped with a reverse-seared tomahawk steak. Somehow it ended up being one of those meals that looked ridiculous on paper but actually turned out incredible. d: TIGER PRAWNS / CORIANDER LIME CHILLI BUTTER 🦐 Coriander, lime, green chilli butter: - In a processor put 3 green chillies, 3 garlic cloves, handful Thai basil, large handful coriander, 2 whole spring onions, lime zest and juice of 1 lime, 1 tbsp ground coriander, 1 tbsp ground coriander, and a generous pinch of salt. Process until chopped - Add 250g pack of unsalted butter, at room temp, and process until combined. Set aside Prawns: - Take 4 large tiger prawns. Snip through between the legs, run a knife through, and split in half lengthways (keeping as 1 piece). Remove the sack from the back - Place on a hot coal BBQ, shell side down until charred and meat is cooked mostly through but not all the way. Remove from heat - In a tray on the BBQ, melt some of the butter. One melted, cook the prawns flesh side down for 20-30s to finish them Serving - Serve the prawns on a platter, covered in the butter, with fresh coriander and lime #cooking #food #prawns #bbq #summer

d: Tokyo Sizzling Smash Burger 🍔🔥 I recreated the Tokyo Sizzling Cheeseburger at home and upgraded it with a pretzel bun 🥨 + two smash patties, American cheese, a homemade burger sauce, and pickles all over a sizzling platter of more cheese 🤤 👉 Full detailed recipes in bio 🔗 — CONDENSED RECIPE ⤵️ Burger Sauce: Mayo, ketchup, yellow mustard, diced dill pickles, pickle juice, garlic powder, salt + black pepper. Mix together and refrigerate. Toast the Bun: Butter a pretzel bun and toast cut-side down until golden. Set aside. Cheese Sauce: American cheese + whole milk over low heat. Whisk until smooth, then add sharp cheddar, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt + black pepper. Keep warm over low heat, whisking occasionally. Add a splash of milk if needed to keep it thin and pourable. Preheat the Sizzling Platter: Place a cast iron fajita skillet (without the wooden base) in a 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Smash Burgers: Smash two 4 oz balls of 75/25 beef on a ripping hot skillet. Season with kosher salt + black pepper. Cook 1½–2 minutes until a deep crust forms. Lower the heat, flip, top with American cheese, cover, and cook another 30–60 seconds until melted. Stack the patties. Build: Bottom bun → burger sauce → dill pickle chips → double smash patties → more burger sauce → top bun. Slice in half. Finish: Pour the warm cheese sauce onto the hot sizzling platter, then immediately place both burger halves cut-side down into the bubbling cheese.  Serve immediately while it's still sizzling and enjoy, friends :)  — #smashburger #tokyo #cheeseburger #recipe #smashburgerrecipe

d: crispy chicken caesar salad croissants 🥗🥐 these over the wraps anyday omg 😣     recipe:   ingredients- 4 thin sliced chicken breasts 1 cup all-purpose flour (120g) seasonings (to taste)- salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend for the wet mixture- 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice for the coating- 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan for the caesar salad- romaine lettuce, chopped croutons extra parmesan other ingredients- 4 large croissants oil for frying garlic butter- 2 tbsp melted butter (28g) 1 clove garlic, minced parsley extra parmesan caesar dressing- 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire sauce ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed) instructions: season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then the panko mixture. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes. fry in oil over medium heat until golden brown and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. transfer to a wire rack. for the dressing, whisk together the mayo, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, dijon, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. slowly whisk in the olive oil, then add water until smooth and pourable. toss the chopped romaine with some of the caesar dressing. add croutons and extra parmesan. slice the croissants in half and spread a little caesar dressing on both sides. add the crispy chicken, top with the caesar salad mixture, and sprinkle with more parmesan. mix together the melted butter, garlic, and parsley. brush the tops of the croissants with the garlic butter and finish with extra parmesan. serve immediately and enjoyyyy    #caesarsalad #crispychicken #croissant #Recipe #EasyRecipe
